segments.text: Reiji is a private investigator who specializes in solving grisly murder cases. He used to be a police detective, but after the tragic death of his fiancée, he left the force. Now, he runs a detective agency in Shinjuku, taking on some of the city's most brutal crimes.

Reiji lives with his younger sister, Yukari, in Suginami, though he's rarely home because he's so focused on his work. Despite his tough exterior, Reiji is a bit of a history buff. When he's not on the job, he loves diving into history books, a passion he likely inherited from his late parents, who were both scholars. Their home is filled with a massive collection of historical books and documents.

In the first episode, Reiji goes undercover as a history teacher at Ouba Girls Academy to investigate a series of mysterious student disappearances, following a request from the school's vice-principal.
Occupation: Private Detective
Hobbies: Reading (mainly history books)
”It’s easy to understand why these criminals do what they do if you give it a little thought.”
Translated and edited from the official site
職業：私立探偵
趣味：読書（主に歴史書）
本作の主人公で、主に凶悪犯罪の調査を請け負う探偵。
元は刑事だったが、とある事件で恋人を失い、辞職した。
現在は、妹の紫と二人暮らしだが、仕事を優先しているため、
自宅にはあまり帰っていない様子。
仕事のない時には歴史書を読み漁る世界史マニアで、
今回の依頼も、世界史の特別講師として女学院に潜入した。
本作的主人公，曾任警察。在某事件中失去了恋人，辞去工作。
现在在新宿经营侦探事务所，主要接受对杀人事件等凶恶犯罪的调查。
家住杉并区，和妹妹紫一起生活，由于工作优先而不怎么回家。
由于那生来的学者气质，在不工作的时候就是搜寻历史书的世界史狂热者。由于已故的双亲曾是学者，家中书库里有大量的藏书。
应樱羽女学院的教导主任所托，作为世界史特别讲师而潜入学院，调查女学生下落不明的事件。
Occupation: Student at Ouba Girls Academy (a member of the art club)
Hobbies: Entomology; raising and keeping bugs
An old-fashioned, reliable type of girl. She takes care of her older brother, who is helpless with household chores. Yukari stops by Reiji’s office periodically to help him clean it up.

She is also an academic like her brother, but with interests rooted in entomology. She keeps various insects inside her room. Don’t let your guard down around her, as some of her insect friends may turn up on the dinner table when you least expect them.
”All I want to do is be there for you, Nii-san.”
Edited from MangaGamer
Yukari believes it would be difficult to make a living through art, and, unable to picture a clear future for herself, she is also troubled over what path to take.
Her relationship with Masaki remains much the same even after they’ve grown older: never too close, never too distant, the two continue to hover somewhere in between.
(Though Yukari, at least, has started to become somewhat more conscious of him.)
職業：櫻羽女学院生（美術部所属）
趣味：虫の観察・飼育
家事ができない兄を支える、古式ゆかしい大和撫子タイプの、できた妹。
探偵事務所も定期的に掃除しており、玲人は色々な面で紫に頭があがらない。
兄と同じく学者肌の面を持ち、虫関係の知識はかなり深い。
自室で様々な虫を飼育しているが、虫が逃げ出したり、
何気なく、虫料理を食卓に並べるため、油断できない。
比玲人小很多的妹妹。由于哥哥对家务一窍不通，自然而然地精通家务了。
当面和背后都支持着哥哥，性格坚强，古老典雅的大和抚子类型。
玲人的侦探事务所由紫定期进行打扫，玲人各方面上在紫面前抬不起头。
和哥哥一样拥有学者气质，其才能主要发挥在与虫有关的方面上，对于虫的方面有着相当丰富的知识。
此外，在自己房间里饲养着各种虫，有时虫会偷跑出来。她有时会若无其事地端出虫料理，在这方面让人丝毫不能大意。
「我只要能成为哥哥的依靠那就足够了。只要这样就行了——」
Occupation: Owner of Cafe Moon World
Hobbies: Making snacks

A widow who owns Cafe Moon World. An old friend of Reiji’s and one of the few people who knows his past. Used to be best friends with Reiji’s deceased fiance, Yukiko. Since they’ve lost someone important, they can connect on a different level. Her cafe has a lot of regulars, including Detective Uozumi and Kuchiki Touko as well.
”Hold on a moment. Let me brew you up some of Kyouko’s special blend.”
Edited from MangaGamer

Kyouko had an adult relationship with Reiji for a time. Two people who had lost someone significant believed they could heal each other's wounds. However, their paths eventually diverged, never to overlap again. She struggles with the realization that Reiji's feelings are no longer with her. But then, something happens...
職業：喫茶店「月世界」オーナー
趣味：お菓子作り
喫茶店「月世界」のオーナーで未亡人。
玲人とっては昔馴染みで、互いの過去を知りあう数少ない友人同士。
玲人の亡くなった恋人・由記子とも親友同士で、
お互いに大切な者を亡くした同士、良き相談相手になっている。
店は常連客も多く、刑事の魚住や冬子など学生も良く訪れているようだ。
离吉祥寺车站很近的咖啡店「月世界」的老板娘。寡妇，从亡夫那里接手了这个店。
和时坂是老相识了，是互相了解对方过去伤痛的为数不多的朋友。称之为孽缘也可以。对时坂抱着单相思，但是知道他心有所属，在为此苦恼。
两人同样失去了最重要的人，彼此间都是很好的倾诉对象。和已逝的时坂的恋人由记子是挚友。
店里很多常客，警察鱼住夹三、冬子等学生也常来。生意十分兴隆。
最近准备让熟人的女儿作为工作人员而住下。
“男人这种生物，对年轻女孩总是黏糊糊的。”
Occupation: Detective
Hobbies: Fishing

A detective with a towering frame. Adept at the physical aspects of the occupation, including footwork. Met Reiji when they were both students; they joined the force and worked under the same supervisor. Still relies on Reiji for help with some cases. Though they tend to joke around with each other, his brawny strength is a good compliment to Reiji's critical thinking skills.
"That's a hell of a way to greet your friend when he's going out of his way to get you what you requested."
From MangaGamer

A longtime friend of Reiji and Kyouko since their school days, Uozumi was unexpectedly promoted and transferred to a regional position following the case related to "The Girl in the Shell." This move led to an unwanted separation from Kyoko, whom he has feelings for. He was mainly concerned for Kyouko after she suffered severe injuries in the incident. This circumstance solidified Uozumi's determination to be the one to protect her.
職業：刑事
趣味：釣り
大柄で強面な、現職の刑事。
見た目通りの肉体派で、足を使った捜査と荒事を担当。
玲人とは学生時代からの付き合いで、同じ上司についていた元同僚。
現在でも、捜査協力を依頼するなど、腐れ縁は切れていないようだ。
互いに軽口を叩き合っているが、頭脳派と肉体派で相性はいい。
現職の刑事で時坂や秋五とは同じ上司の下で働いていた｡大柄かつ強面なため下手な犯罪者よりよほど迫力がある｡
見た目通りの肉体派｡頭脳労働は苦手と割り切り､自らは足を使った捜査と荒事担当として先陣を走る｡
時坂とは学生時代からの付き合いがあり､現在も捜査協力を依頼するなど腐れ縁は切れていない｡
互いに軽口を叩き合ってはいるが頭脳派と肉体派で相性はいいようだ｡
｢ご挨拶だな､ﾃﾒｪに頼まれたﾌﾞﾂを持ってきたんだろうが｣
Nishizono Yui's best friend. As a result, she often runs into Yukari and the rest of the art club members. Became rather depressed after Yui disappeared, and as a result, doesn't talk to others much.
Edited from MangaGamer
Ayumu's a female student aspiring to be a detective assistant and is Yukari's junior. Her fervent sense of justice and androgynous charm have earned her popularity among her peers.

While she is determined to pursue her dream, the path to becoming a detective assistant is not straightforward, especially as it requires Reiji's consent, which she has yet to secure. Currently, she's thoughtfully contemplating her next steps to pursue her ambition.
職業：櫻羽女学院生（剣道部所属）
趣味：剣道
西園唯の親友。
その関係で、紫たち美術部の面々とも面識がある。
唯が行方不明になってから、意気消沈気味で、
他の人ともあまり関わろうとしなくなった。
希望成为侦探助手的女子学生，同时也是剑道部的王牌。
正义感很强很讲礼貌的热血少女，散发出冷酷的中性气质。
仅一年，身材和胸部就有了很明显的发育。
因此加强了中性的气质，不那麽像男孩子了。
“我也一起去，毕竟我是时坂先生的助手。”
Touko's mother. A taciturn, gloomy lady who seems rather frail. Doesn't get out much; she devotes all her time to her household duties.
Edited from MangaGamer

Chizuru is Touko's adoptive mother, taking her in as a foster child during her early years. At first, Chizuru earnestly worked on building a mother-daughter bond. However, as Touko grew older and more beautiful, Chizuru noticed her brother, Fumiya, becoming attracted to Touko. This realization caused a rift to develop in their relationship. For Chizuru, her brother was her entire world, and the agony of feeling him drawn to Touko was unbearable.
職業：専業主婦
冬子の母親。
物静かで、儚い雰囲気を持っており、
その雰囲気同様、身体が丈夫でない。
あまり外に出歩かず、主婦業に専念している。
朽木冬子的养母。
很冷静的性格，有些阴沉的女性。母子关系并不是很好。
不时从玲人那裏听取寻找冬子的情况，也一直在协助。
“……我没有阻止你的权力。”
Touko's uncle. A calm, friendly man. Touko is very precious to him.
From MangaGamer
職業：医者
冬子の伯父。
穏やかで気さくな性格。
冬子の事を、とても大切にしている。
沉稳而爽快的性格，是千鹤的哥哥。
壳之少女事件之後，代替引咎辞职的父亲成为了朽木医院（过去的朽木病理学研究所）的院长。
作为院长以诚恳的态度完成自己的责任，从而使因诱拐事件而失去的患者的信用慢慢回升。
对时坂基本上是很协助的。
“……毕竟有之前的事，这也是没办法的呀。”
An odd girl with a peculiar air to her. Everything about her is eccentric, including her actions, words, and conduct.
She looks strange carrying a stuffed rabbit around everywhere and talking to it, but she’s actually incredibly smart.
"What a nice old man, right, Carol?"
From MangaGamer
She is the daughter of Fuyumi & Masaki.
Yukiko's mother. She raised Yukiko by herself while also working at a nursery.
She’s very candid, but is also exceptionally good at looking after others. She’s a regular customer at the coffee shop "Moon World" and is also an acquaintance of Kyouko.
"I want some coffee too, Hazuki-chan."
From MangaGamer
Her real name is Ayako. Marked by a past incident, she was, in many ways, reborn as someone else. She also remains bound to Tomoyuki Masaki by ties not easily severed.
In March 1956, a chance encounter at Inokashira Park brought Touko and Detective Tokisaka Reiji together. The young girl, searching for her origins, sought his aid.

Drawn to his understanding, the deeply lonely Touko began to emerge from her shell, finding a fragile solace with Reiji in their shared wounds. But then, a terrible accident left Touko critically injured—and she disappeared.
Unseen, unheard, a new life stirred within her…
Based on the official site

A coroner who forbids anyone to address her as anything but "Natsume-san". Though she can be rather shady with her words and actions, her skill as a coroner is undisputed. Reiji met her during his time on the force, and still relies on her for important information. However, he tries to stay away from her as much as possible, as she tends to require "something" in exchange for information.
From MangaGamer
She is the older sister of Shuugo & Nana.

An obstetrician at the Kuchiki Pathological Research Institute. A gentle person with a serious demeanor who likes taking care of people. Helps out during Reiji's investigation. Due to the small amount of doctors they have available, she often has to help with things other than her actual field of obstetrics.
"If you understand that... You’re not a child, so you know what you have to do, right?"
From MangaGamer
She was arrested over 10 years ago for killing her child, but wasn't charged due to temporary insanity.

A curator at the Tokyo Art Museum. Maris first met Reiji during an investigation involving the 'Girl of the Shell.' She rarely talks and usually speaks in broken Japanese but becomes strangely eloquent when discussing paintings.

She is the daughter of an Italian missionary, Christopher Berg Stella, and a Japanese nun, Katsuragi Motoko. Her personal history includes overcoming mutism, aided by Rokushiki's treatment, and her late sister, Celestial Stella, was Rokushiki's lover.
Based on the official site and Wikipedia

A police officer who was part of the investigation team for the Ueno's serial killer and murder mystery. After the case was solved, he was transferred and promoted and became a police officer of the National Police Agency in the Kara no Shoujo series.

Ryouichi's childhood was overshadowed by an older brother, leading to abuse from his father. Tragically, his sister Eriko took the brunt of this abuse, culminating in her current condition. He relentlessly strives for promotion to prevent others from suffering the same fate as his sister.
A suspicious old man who sells takoyaki of doubtful origin.

Masaki is an unemployed man whose life takes a dramatic turn. His story begins in Inokashira Park, where a failed suicide attempt leads him to cross paths with Tokisaka Yukari, who finds and rescues him.

Following his recovery in the hospital, he joins the Tokisaka Detective Agency as a temporary assistant. This opportunity arises partly because of his inability to fully use his left hand, a consequence of his suicide attempt. Furthermore, he feels a sense of obligation towards Tokisaka, who not only saved his life but also gave him a blood transfusion.

Despite his grumblings about the demanding nature of the work, Masaki continues to assist Reiji. Lacking other pursuits in life and driven by his passive disposition, he sees this role as a path to follow for now. Masaki is known for his mature personality, which, depending on the situation, can be both an asset and a hindrance. He tends to maintain a distance from others, creating a barrier that defines his interactions and relationships.
”...It looks like I’ve escaped death once again.”
Edited from MangaGamer
Showing no disturbance at the death of a close acquaintance, Ayato was noted for his diminished emotions and was prompted to resume visits to the psychiatrist he had previously seen.
Currently, he is aiding in the search for a childhood friend who has turned into a criminal and disappeared.
A girl who just joined Yukari’s class at Ouba Girls’ Academy. She’s a shy, meek girl who avoids interacting with others.
She’s extremely socially awkward and doesn’t adapt well to her new class until Yukari and Kohane start talking to her, after which she opens up to them.

While interacting with Yukari, she became interested in painting and joined the art club. Before joining the art club, her only hobby was reading. On an unrelated note, she appears to be very well developed for her somewhat unbalanced diet: there are days when she would only eat rice and boiled fish paste.
”...I’m sorry. I have a terrible memory...”
Edited from MangaGamer
She now works as a freelance journalist, but she was once a high-ranking member of an organization called the "Hand of Death" based in Ueno.
She’s retired from the organization and now has her own small business.
Awakening to her love of journalism after the Senri incident, Touji now investigates things such as social issues on her own.
"...You’re pretty awful. You work people even harder than Shuugo."
From MangaGamer
Originally a psychiatrist, Rokushiki was a genius who aimed to master all aspects of medical knowledge and technique.

Rokushiki was arrested by Tokisaka, with whom he shares a complex history, during the resolution of the 'Girl of the Shell' case involving Mamiya Shinzou. He has been detained for over two years in a substitute prison operated by the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department.
He has intricate connections not just with Tokisaka but also with Masaki.

A young and eccentric psychiatrist who was assigned to Masaki after the arrest of his previous one. She often chides and tries to provoke him. She seems to be really interested in Rokushiki. According to Masaki, she's able to "read minds".
Real name: Tamura Shizuka (多邑 静)
One of the recently missing girls.
She is Touko and Reiji's daughter kidnapped by Naori and later adopted by the Saegusa family.
One of the recently missing girls.
She is Maezono Sei and Sasakura Keita's daughter.
